threshold_selection.note: t=0.90 was not tuned. Persius rows are the frozen 400 test, Hard rows are the frozen 100, and the 370 prior-auth rows are the shared held-out set this bench reports. No DeepInfra answers exist on a separate dev or practice split. The dial file holds the curve from 0.50 to 1.00. post_hoc_on_reported_rows is the cheapest point within 1 point of the escalation model on these same rows. It is not the operating point.

formulas.rule: Drex keeps every question with recorded confidence >= 0.90. The rest take this model's recorded answer to the same question.
formulas.cases: Only cases in the longest prefix of the frozen order where both Drex and this model have a non-error recorded answer. partial is true when that prefix is shorter than the frozen set.
formulas.cost_per_1000_usd: cost per 1,000 cases = mean(Drex recorded cost_usd + routed DeepInfra cost) * 1000. Routed cost is 0 when no question is sent. Otherwise it is the recorded packed call, scaled as (list input dollars + list output dollars * routed/asked) * (recorded cost_usd / list-price of that call) when cost_basis is provider_estimated_cost and both the recorded cost and the list price are positive. List rates are DeepInfra's published cents_per_token figures from _deepinfra_list. If the provider did not send estimated_cost, the scale is 1 and the list rate is used. If no list rate is known, the recorded cost_usd is scaled by routed/asked. The escalation model alone uses mean(recorded cost_usd) * 1000 and no Drex cost. Drex alone uses mean(recorded Drex cost_usd) * 1000 and no DeepInfra cost. On prior auth, a case with any routed question takes the escalation model's recorded decision and the other case-level parts; Drex keeps those when nothing is routed.
formulas.latency_p50_ms: p50 latency is the median over paired cases of [Drex recorded latency_ms + DeepInfra recorded latency_ms * routed/asked when any question is routed]. Drex alone is the median Drex latency. The escalation model alone is the median of its recorded latency.

match_qwen_within_1pt.post_hoc: Operating point t=0.90. Not tuned: no DeepInfra answers on a dev or practice split. The star is this fixed point, not a search over the reported rows.
match_qwen_within_1pt.label: simulated from recorded answers

post_hoc_on_reported_rows.post_hoc: Threshold picked on the same recorded set it is scored on. Not a held-out choice.
post_hoc_on_reported_rows.rule: lowest simulated cost among points whose chart metric is within 1 point of this model alone. Reported only as a post-hoc description of these rows.
post_hoc_on_reported_rows.label: simulated from recorded answers
post_hoc_on_reported_rows.note: Scored on the same rows. Not used as the operating point.
